vehicle_class: generic representative double-deck; explicit assumptions, not a production specification
grade_rule: HGT rounded nearest endpoint / route interval length; no smoothing; clip +/-0.15 with flag; missing blocks
cap_rule: directed registered local intervals only; conservative conditional-minimum assumption explicitly labelled; missing or unresolved blocks

randomness.algorithm: UTF8 compact JSON [namespace,master_seed,...typed_fields]; BLAKE2s digest_size=8; big-endian uint / 2**64
randomness.production_replication: C11/C13 precision process; not selected by C06
randomness.cross_pattern_dependence: independent distinct patterns; equivalent patterns share infrastructure

assumption_rationale.passengers: 20 is a simple nonzero controlled nominal load within the assumed 85 passenger capacity, independently proposed here; historical fallback is provenance only, not adoption
assumption_rationale.temperature: 22 C is an explicit neutral cabin/environment reference within historical 18-26 C deadband; no thermal calculation or solar lookup
assumption_rationale.auxiliaries: 3 kW retains the explicitly assumed lights/doors/controls/fans base; zero HVAC is a controlled condition, not an observed thermal balance
assumption_rationale.outstanding: register these scalars, vehicle/dwell assumptions and date scope before C18; W04 practical thresholds and computational limits remain proposals
